mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS travel_plan_id, p.title AS title, p.start_date AS start_date, p.end_date AS end_date, p.representative_image_url AS representative_image_url, m.role AS role, p.last_activity_at AS last_activity_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM travel_plan_members active_member WHERE active_member.travel_plan_id = p.id AND active_member.status = #{memberStatus}) AS member_count FROM travel_plan_members m JOIN travel_plans p ON p.id = m.travel_plan_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = #{memberStatus} AND p.status = #{planStatus} ORDER BY p.last_activity_at DESC, p.id DESC
